title: Custom Landing Page content model
description: Canonical schema for landing.json. This is the shared source of truth for both PIP (prism_platform/v2/modules/landing_page_intake, writes this) and prism-hub (~/prism/marketer/render-landing.mjs, reads this). Backward compatible with the original 8-key dell.landing.json / nike.landing.json -- `sections` and `theme` are additive and optional; existing files validate unchanged.

sections.description: Chosen section/variant composition, in render order. Optional -- absent means the original fixed flow (hero, proof, roi, findings, capabilities, cta_band, footer), preserving dell/nike as-is. See docs/workspace/custom-landing-page/00-design-system.md Section Inventory for the variant catalog.

theme.description: Optional brand-token overrides. Null/absent means render with the default Algolia tokens from 00-design-system.md -- this key existing at all is an escape hatch, never a requirement.
